ticket.title: the receipt commit window collapses to the HEAD commit when merge-base resolution returns nothing
ticket.description: OBSERVED 2026-11-07: GB-302's receipt reads `[1 commit(s)]` for a one-commit change, and so did SP-32's - but for the wrong reason. `commit_shas` degrades to just the HEAD commit whenever base..head resolves empty, which happens when the claim's base commit IS HEAD (a ticket claimed or re-claimed after its work is committed). The count is not false so much as narrower than it looks. FIXED in 2bf55df: the base is now the widest valid candidate among the claim base and the merge-base against main, and a window that cannot be named says so in the receipt summary.
